Description (English): An example advice service for planning journeys and finding transport with the access features you need.
Access notes: A real transport listing should describe vehicle access, booking notice, and whether assistance is available.

Description (English): An example community group connecting people with practical help for everyday routines.
Access notes: A real support listing should explain eligibility, languages, availability, and how helpers are selected.

Description (English): An example neighbourhood meeting place with detailed information about its entrance and facilities.
Access notes: A real venue listing should include doorway measurements, toilet details, and information about noise and seating.

Description (English): An example service offering advice about mobility equipment and adapting everyday spaces.
Access notes: A real equipment listing should describe rental or purchase options, fitting, costs, and maintenance.

Description (English): An example clinic showing how appointment accessibility and communication options could be described.
Access notes: A real health listing should explain appointment arrangements and link to the provider’s own information.

Description (English): An example information point for finding official guidance and help navigating public services.
Access notes: A real rights listing should link to current official guidance and clearly state the scope of its advice.

Description (English): An example inclusive arts group with information on sensory needs, communication, and participation.
Access notes: This example intentionally has no step-free access. Access needs should be described individually, rather than with one general label.

Description (English): An example advice service for exploring home access improvements and arranging an initial conversation.
Access notes: A real home adaptations listing should explain assessment options, service area, and how quotations work.
